title: Proven-optimal and improved k-selection comparator networks (SEL(n,k)) via validated SAT + evolutionary search
problem: Minimal-size comparator networks placing the k smallest of n inputs on wires 0..k-1 (property SEL(n,k)); no published proven optima or best-known table exists for this property.
hypothesis: A slot-model SAT encoding (validated against literature-proven sorter optima and brute force) proves exact minima at small n, and hybrid evolution with error-guided remove-and-repair beats derived upper bounds at mid n.
baseline: (a) best-known record sorters truncated+pruned to selectors; (b) SorterHunter median-selection networks (Dobbelaere, fetched 2026-08-26); (c) for sorters: published best-known 45/51/56/60/71 CEs for N=13..17.
proposed_improvement: ES with (error,size) lexicographic fitness + crossover between Pareto-record seeds + SAT decision procedure with sound symmetry breaking for exact values.

experimental_evidence.how_to_reproduce: python select_baselines.py && python search_es.py --mode select --n 16 --k 8 ... && python merge_runs.py runs_sel16_8

experimental_evidence.what: Negative result on sorter records N=13..17
experimental_evidence.result: no improvement over published records in ~40 CPU-min/target

adversarial_attacks: encoder validated: reproduces s(3)=3,s(4)=5,s(5)=9 (SAT at optimum, UNSAT below); agrees with brute-force SEL(4,2)=4, SEL(5,2)=6
every claimed network re-verified by two independent exhaustive verifiers in fresh processes
witness networks decoded from SAT models re-verified before recording
novelty_notes: No prior proven-optimal or best-known tables found for general-k selection property SEL(n,k) (audit in ../literature/S5-novelty.md sections B,D). Median-network records (Dobbelaere) are a stronger-constrained variant and serve as baselines only.
proof_status: experimentally_validated_result (exact small-n values are proven_result modulo written completeness argument in REPORT.md)
next_action: independent reproduction from SPEC alone; extend exact search to n=9..10 with better symmetry breaking
